# Bundled map libraries

Original distribution files downloaded on 2026-10-02:

- Leaflet 1.9.4: https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/ — BSD-2-Clause, see leaflet-LICENSE.txt.
- Leaflet-Geoman Free 2.18.3: https://unpkg.com/@geoman-io/leaflet-geoman-free@2.18.3/dist/ — MIT, see geoman-LICENSE.txt.

Leaflet images are stored in images/ at their original relative CSS paths.
Local copies avoid runtime dependence on an external CDN. Release report.json
records SHA-256 for every bundled asset.
